neighbours.label: The opening of a parenthetical that restates a measurement in other units: ' (' right after a quantity with its unit ('12 miles (19 km)'), and the range dash before such a conversion; other parentheticals and bare measurements stay quiet
fire: The farm sits about 8 miles (13 km) south of the border.
The tank holds 50 gallons (189 liters) of rainwater.
The pipe carries 4 – 9 gallons (15 – 34 liters) per minute.
The trail climbs 2,000 feet (610 m) in the first hour.
The boulder weighs 3 tons (2,700 kg) and blocks the path.
The radar can track aircraft 60 nautical miles (111 km) away.
The island covers 120 square miles (311 sq km) of forest.
The snake grows to 6 feet (1.8 m) in length.
quiet: The farm sits about 8 miles south of the border.
The tank holds 50 gallons of rainwater in winter.
The mayor (a retired teacher) opened the fair.
The trail was closed in 2019 (see the notice) for repairs.
The boulder weighs 3 tons and blocks the path.
The radar (an older design) can track aircraft at night.
The match ended 4 – 2 after extra time.
The snake (a python) grows quickly in its first year.
